_meta.how_this_works: Each trigger has an 'expression' (which Mo face to show — used for BOTH the in-app mascot display AND as the icon attached to any browser notification for that trigger) plus light/dark variants, each split into 'low'/'high' pools on the personality slider (0-100).

theme_personality.light_pastel: Baseline warm, soft, comforting, nurturing. 'low' = pure warmth. 'high' = playful mischief and teasing, still affectionate, never mean.
theme_personality.dark_scifi: Baseline dry, stoic, deadpan, done-with-you. 'low' = clipped stoic observations. 'high' = genuinely sarcastic, annoyed, roasting.

_meta.expression_mapping: Mo has these expression files per theme: idle, happy, sleepy, focused, goblin. When a goblin_bonus line is used (chaos level = goblin), always show the 'goblin' expression instead of the trigger's normal expression, regardless of theme.
_meta.shuffle_bag: Per trigger+theme+pool: track shown lines in localStorage, never repeat until the whole pool has played once, then reshuffle, never repeat back-to-back even across reshuffles.

sliders.personality: 0-100 per theme, stored independently. Below 50 pulls 'low' pool, 50+ pulls 'high' pool.
sliders.sarcasm: none | mild | maximum — scales sharpness of the 'high' pool for task/deadline triggers specifically. 'none' pins those triggers to 'low' regardless of slider.
sliders.chaos: minimal | normal | goblin — goblin merges in goblin_bonus lines and swaps in the goblin expression.
